text:
maya: shared a quick prototype for the trace action bar. main question: should export be hidden in the overflow or visible as a tertiary button? figma: https://www.figma.com/file/trace-actionbar-proto :mag:

derek: my vote: keep export in overflow. it's low-frequency and adding it inline competes with troubleshooting actions.

sasha: +1 but make export discoverable via Command+E shortcut and show it in the kebab with clear labels like 'Export full event (JSON)' and 'Export frames (CSV)'.

maya: good idea on shortcut. also thinking about split copy control: primary click copies trace id, caret opens menu with request id / correlation chain. minimizes clicks for common case.

lee: split button sounds efficient. please ensure the caret is keyboard-targetable and the control exposes aria-expanded and aria-controls. keyboard: Enter toggles, arrows navigate.

a11y-bot: checklist: split button must be operable by keyboard, use role=button on both parts, and announce state changes. use an aria-live polite region for successful copies with contextual text (e.g., 'Trace id 0x12 copied'). ensure focus returns to trigger after modal close.

derek: export modal: show two presets and an "advanced" toggle. presets: 'Frames (CSV)' and 'Event (JSON)'. show tiny preview and an estimated size. backend can return estimates so we don't block UI.

sasha: also add an option in modal: include breadcrumbs/context or omit them to reduce size. label it clearly: 'Include trace context (adds service/endpoint metadata)'.

maya: mobile behavior: collapse to two controls: Back + kebab. copy actions move inside kebab to keep header compact.

lee: microcopy: change generic 'Download' to explicit actions like 'Export frames (CSV)'. tooltips should be two lines max. for copy confirmations avoid single word toasts; use 'Request ID copied 123ab 120000' (contextual and helpful).

a11y-bot: ensure color contrast for action icons meets 4.5:1. for motion, respect prefers-reduced-motion for any success animations. provide visible focus rings for all interactive elements.

derek: one more backend note: export endpoint should accept a columns list and selection filter; if large, return a job id and link to download when ready. UI should show expected time or size estimate.

maya: thanks. i'll update the prototype with split copy, kebab-only mobile, and explicit export labels + shortcut hint. will tag ux + a11y for quick pass once done.

sasha: quick follow-up: in the kebab, prefix export items with filetype icons (CSV/JSON) to help glanceability. accessibility: also include the filetype in aria-label.

maya: noted. pushing updates tonight.

lee: thanks team. small changes but should reduce confusion and improve discoverability for power workflows. :tada:
